text:
lina-support: FYI customer on private deploy (air-gapped mode) reporting API calls intermittently 502/timeout. They say outbound traffic must go via corporate SOCKS5 proxy and they get TLS handshake errors in the agent logs. Any quick checks?

support-bot: Automated check: no platform-wide incidents. Suggest collecting diagnostics.

tom-infra: Ask them for the agent logs (/var/log/redwood/agent.log) and the curl debug output. Also need their env vars: HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY, NO_PROXY.

lina-support: They pasted a snippet: 
```
2026-03-12T09:12:03Z error: http: TLS handshake error from 10.0.2.5: remote error: tls: handshake failure
2026-03-12T09:12:03Z warn: failed fetch model list: GET https://registry.redwood.ai/v1/models: proxyconnect tcp: dial tcp 10.1.2.3:1080: connect: connection timed out
```

ryan-eng: Two quick things: 1) confirm agent process is honoring the proxy env vars (systemd service file vs shell). 2) test curl with the same proxy and hostname to reproduce. Example command: 
```
curl -v --proxy socks5h://10.1.2.3:1080 https://registry.redwood.ai/health
```

victor-sre: Also run a DNS check from the host: `dig +short registry.redwood.ai` and `getent hosts registry.redwood.ai`. If the proxy expects different routing (split-DNS) the agent might be sending to wrong egress.

lina-support: I asked for the agent's env from systemd: `systemctl show redwood-agent --property=Environment` and they provided this: 
```
Environment=HTTPS_PROXY=socks5://10.1.2.3:1080 HTTP_PROXY=socks5://10.1.2.3:1080 NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,10.0.0.0/8
```

tom-infra: Two follow-ups: 1) socks5 vs socks5h difference (hostnames vs IP resolution). If proxy should resolve hostnames, they need socks5h in env. 2) systemd requires Environment= with proper url scheme; some agents parse only HTTP(S) proxies. Try setting `HTTPS_PROXY=socks5h://10.1.2.3:1080` and restart.

lina-support: They changed to socks5h and restarted service. Logs show different error now: 
```
2026-03-12T09:18:21Z error: GET https://registry.redwood.ai/v1/models: 502 proxy error: CONNECT failed: 407 Proxy Authentication Required
```

ryan-eng: 407 confirms proxy auth is required. If their proxy uses NTLM/Negotiate, the agent won't do that out of the box. Options: 1) run a local auth proxy (eg. cntlm/ntlmaps) that handles NTLM and forwards to the corporate proxy, and point agent to localhost:3128, 2) configure the corporate proxy to allow the redwood endpoints unauthenticated, or 3) use an egress gateway in their VPC that has auth.

victor-sre: Also double-check NO_PROXY for internal IPs of registry or any egress gateway. If they can let traffic bypass the corporate proxy for `registry.redwood.ai`, simplest path is to add it to NO_PROXY and ensure routing allows direct egress.

lina-support: Customer tried local cntlm, set `HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:3128` and agent can now list models. But downloads still fail with TLS errors (seems the corporate proxy is re-signing certs).

tom-infra: Add the corporate MITM CA into the agent host truststore. For Linux (Debian/Ubuntu): 
```
cp corp-mitm-ca.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/corp-mitm-ca.crt
update-ca-certificates
systemctl restart redwood-agent
```
If the agent bundles its own trust store, put the CA into that bundle or set `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE`/`SSL_CERT_FILE` env appropriately.

ryan-eng: Another test: `curl --proxy http://127.0.0.1:3128 -v https://registry.redwood.ai/health` should succeed after CA import. If curl still shows a cert issued by the proxy, the agent needs the same CA trust.

lina-support: They imported CA and now agent downloads succeeded. Customer says final issue was corporate proxy doing TLS inspection + NTLM auth + they were using socks5 (no hostname resolve). Fix was: run local NTLM auth proxy + use socks5h/http proxy to localhost + import MITM CA.

victor-sre: Good. For long term: recommend documenting in private deploy quickstart: required egress hosts, example systemd service env, local auth proxy pattern, and offline cache option. Also add a check in agent startup for proxy auth failures to print clearer troubleshooting hints (407 -> "proxy auth required: consider local auth helper or NO_PROXY").

lina-support: Customer confirmed end-to-end and asked to close. Marking resolved. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Thread closed automatically after 24h of inactivity.
